integrity: The complex is reconstructed from the published graph Čech generator formula. A standalone exact verifier checks every face, every Hasse cover, matching acyclicity, critical-cell counts, the signed Morse boundary, and modular simplicial homology cross-checks.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the intrinsic graph Čech complex at scale three on the four-dimensional hypercube. It does not settle the scale-three homotopy type for higher-dimensional hypercubes or the broader layer-decomposition conjectures.
title: Exact homotopy type of the scale-three Čech complex of the four-cube
